hero.title: European supplier of hyaluronic acid fillers
hero.subtitle: Improved by science, inspired by lifestyle.
hero.descriptionBridge: There is a bridge between Europe and the rest of the world – a meeting point between cultural trends and scientific innovation – embodied in a brand of high-quality hyaluronic acid injectable fillers, medical devices, and sterile cosmetic solutions for professionals.
hero.descriptionBrand: Bonitto is the name of this brand: an European supplier of hyaluronic acid fillers, professional cosmetics, and advanced skincare products. Combining Italian manufacturing excellence with the precision and rigor of Viennese distribution, Bonitto expresses a vision of vitality, wellness, and timeless style.
hero.descriptionVision: With a carefully curated range of premium products designed to enhance natural beauty, rejuvenate the skin, and deliver safe, effective results, Bonitto encourages a new aesthetic culture devoted to celebrating all forms of beauty.

technology.title: HA italian made fillers and formulations
technology.highlight: More than beauty, an experience of wellness and self-confidence.
technology.description: Blending cutting-edge research and technology with the timeless allure of classic elegance, Bonitto stands out for its high-performance dermal fillers, professional cosmetics, and advanced skincare formulations.

leadership.title: European leader in medicine formulation
leadership.highlight: Natural beauty inspired by classical sculptural masterpieces.
leadership.description: With advanced formulations and a wide selection of fillers, mesotherapy solutions, and skincare products, Bonitto is devoted to personal care and the ongoing exploration of the relationship between inner well-being and outer beauty.

news.title: news & events
news.description: Follow a refreshed, rejuvenated version of yourself with Bonitto®. Explore a world made of lifestyle and science.
